name: openbafang-cannable
description: CAN bus interface for Bafang motor controllers

comments.build: Builds every target in pkg.targets using @yao-pkg/pkg (Vercel's pkg is archived).
comments.build:win: Windows x64 only - fastest path when that is all you need.
comments.entry: bin points at app.js, not server.js: app.js unpacks the native USB binary before requiring the server. See BUILD_EXE.md.
comments.targets: node22, not node18: pkg-fetch ships no prebuilt node18 binary any more, so an 18 target falls back to compiling Node from source and needs Visual Studio.
